title: Bonemaw meat
content:
# Bonemaw meat

Type: Material | Internal ID: BoneMawSerpentMeat | Source: Bonemaw | Usage: Iron cooking station | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes

# Introduction

Bonemaw meat is a guarantee drop from Bonemaws located in the boiling waters of the Ashlands. After slaying the serpent, the meat will float for a considerable time.
It can be cooked on an Iron cooking station over a lit Campfire to obtain Cooked bonemaw meat, or Coal if overcooked.

## Availability

• Creature: Bonemaw | 0 Star: 6-7

## Usage

• Cooked bonemaw meat
• Coal, if left on an Iron cooking station for too long

## Notes

• Unlike Cooked serpent meat, Bonemaw meat is not used for any crafted foods. Despite this, it has one of the highest health gains in the game at 90.
• Bonemaw meat is very heavy, it is best to avoid carrying unnecessarily too much of it.

Categorias: Materials, Food
